SELECT user_id AS userId, MAX(create_time) AS lastViewTime, MAX(ip) AS lastViewIp, MAX(user_purchase_amount) AS userPurchaseAmount, MAX(user_purchase_num) AS userPurchaseNum FROM author_article_pv_logs WHERE author_id = #{authorId} AND article_id = #{articleId} AND deleted = 0
